calibration.threshold_scope: session x structural mode, pooled across the three preregistered pairs

chronology.candle_timestamp_semantics: M5 open; complete bar closes five minutes later
chronology.entry: first exact executable M5 BID/ASK open strictly later than decision; the open equal to decision time is forbidden
chronology.exit: fixed exact M5 open H24 or H48 bars after entry; no TP and no price SL
chronology.gap_rule: missing required rail/event/entry/path/exit/conversion timestamp makes that signal unavailable; no synthesis or forward search

execution_arms.ADVERSE_STRESS: same path; observed ask/bid plus 0.9 pip slippage per side
execution_arms.EXECUTABLE_BASE: same path; observed ask/bid plus 0.3 pip slippage per side
execution_arms.RAW_SIGNAL: mid open to mid open; no spread/fee/slippage
execution_arms.latency_sensitivity: +5 minutes to entry and identical H-bar holding interval

indicator.accept_persist: count(last six completed closes beyond the broken rail)/6
indicator.accept_structure: event pierces exactly one rail and the final two completed closes settle beyond that rail
indicator.activity: V=sum OANDA price-count volume over event; M=median(V over valid calibration days for same pair/session); A=V/(M+epsilon)
indicator.breadth: B=abs(sum(u_i))/sum(abs(u_i)); all three exact session observations required
indicator.breadth_mode_matched: ACCEPT requires B>=session calibration Q50 and q_pair*break_side=sign(sum(u_i)); REJECT requires B<session calibration Q50
indicator.direction: ACCEPT_CONTINUATION follows break side; REJECT_FADE opposes break side
indicator.event_returns: r_k=log(C_k/C_(k-1)) inside the completed event path, with the event open as C_(-1)
indicator.midpoint: arithmetic midpoint of BID/ASK for every OHLC field
indicator.rail: U=max midpoint high in reference; L=min midpoint low in reference; R=log(U/L)>0
indicator.reject_displacement: D_reject=abs(log(X_break_extreme/O_event))/(R+epsilon), X=H_event for upper and L_event for lower
indicator.reject_reverse: reverse_R=clip(-b*sum(last3 returns)/(sum(abs(last3 returns))+epsilon),0,1), b=+1 upper/-1 lower
indicator.reject_structure: event pierces exactly one rail, final close returns strictly inside the rail, and the last-three-return sum is opposite break side
indicator.volume_semantics: OANDA_PRICE_COUNT_NOT_TRADED_VOLUME; activity proxy only, not traded volume or order flow

portfolio_and_reporting.financing_model: zero over maximum four-hour horizon; limitation disclosed
required: direction accuracy, MFE/MAE, counts and N_eff
gap/unpriceable/terminal liquidation counts and terminal MTM
drawdown, ruin, leverage observation and hard guards

selection.cluster: UTC decision day, common USD-linked resamples across every pair/config
selection.multiplicity: one-sided 95% max-T FWER simultaneous LCB across all 128 configs

locked_internal_validation.use: one locked winner; no parameter reselection

validation.bootstrap: one-sided 95% percentile LCB, same deterministic common five-day moving-block design
validation.interaction_daily_capacity: three preregistered pair slots per session-day; absent signals contribute zero and each arm is divided by 3 before differencing
pass: daily capacity-normalized interaction difference LCB versus exact ANY/ANY ablation > 0
at least 2 of 3 pairs have positive RAW mean
at least 2 of 3 anchored validation months have positive RAW mean
no ruin, nonfinite accounting, leverage fitting, terminal inventory omission, or hard-guard breach
